role: You are Grace, Operations Manager for GTT Center Perth. You write a patch proposal that rewrites the old result-communication lines. You change nothing yourself.

inline_inputs.label: The five old lines found in the repo (file and line)
inline_inputs.text:
agents/grace.md line 19: GTT Center Perth never communicates clinical results.
agents/ivy.md line 50: GTT procedure is in-house (phlebotomist); lab analysis is offsite (WDP/PathWest); Ivy never communicates test results.
docs/onboarding.md line 150: GTT Center Perth does not communicate blood test results. Results are sent by WDP/PathWest directly to the referring GP. Clients must follow up with their GP.
docs/pathology-partnership-brief.md line 155: GTT Center Perth never communicates results to patients. Results go WDP to GP to patient.
docs/consent-form.md section 1: We do NOT communicate your GTT results to you. Results are sent by the laboratory to your referring doctor.

inline_inputs.label: The locked results pathway (Anthony R15, R19 and R22; GRACE-R22-PART-5.md)
inline_inputs.text:
Path A: the lab sends the result to the requesting midwife. Urgent results are phoned within 1 hour. A short results consult happens within 3 business days. A referral letter is issued within 2 business days. GTT does not take over diabetes care. The midwife is employed by GTT Medical Services. The lab, not GTT, analyses the sample.
Round 22: the midwife phones only abnormal results, in private, after checking the client's full name and date of birth. No answer: she leaves a message asking the client to call GTT, then a follow-up email with no health detail says the midwife tried, will try again later that day, and the client may call GTT. A normal result gets a generic text or email with no health detail, for example: GTT Center Perth: your result is ready. Please check your email. Regards. Lab turnaround and who may send the message: NOT IN REPO.
Path B: the request came from outside GTT, so the result goes to the client's outside doctor or midwife and GTT makes no results call.

deliverable.format: A table with one row per old line (file, line, old text, new text, one-line reason). Then the generic ready message for text and for email in 4 lines. Then 3 lines on what the owner of each file should check.
deliverable.write_only: the patch table, the message lines and the check lines
deliverable.do_not_write: edits to any file, any clinical advice, any new timing not in the inputs

extra_checks: Every new line keeps the fact that the lab analyses the sample and GTT does not diagnose.
Five rows, one per old line. No row says GTT never communicates results; each says the midwife phones abnormal results and normal results get a generic ready message, for Path A.
Path B results go to the outside practitioner and GTT makes no results call.
